title: LAN Server Options
description: Advanced LAN settings for Minecraft Java 26.2 on Fabric.
body:
LAN Server Options adds an **Advanced options** screen to Minecraft's built-in LAN flow.

It lets the LAN host configure extra integrated-server settings before opening the world:

- Toggle `online-mode`.
- Toggle whitelist flags.
- Toggle PvP.
- Change the LAN MOTD/server message.
- Change the maximum player count from `1` to `100`.
- Change the idle timeout from `0` to `1440` minutes.

Only the player hosting the LAN world needs the mod. Joining players can use vanilla Minecraft.

## Requirements

- Minecraft Java `26.2`
- Fabric Loader `0.19.3` or newer for `26.2`
- Java `25`

Fabric API is not required.

## Security note

Disabling `online-mode` turns off account verification. Use it only on trusted networks because other players can impersonate usernames.
